evidence.title: Waking Sleeping Beauty
evidence.text: Waking Sleeping Beauty is a 2009 American documentary film directed by Disney film producer Don Hahn and produced by Hahn and former Disney executive Peter Schneider.

evidence.title: Waking Sleeping Beauty
evidence.text: The film documents the history of Walt Disney Feature Animation from 1984 to 1994, covering the rise of a period referred to as the Disney Renaissance.

evidence.title: Waking Sleeping Beauty
evidence.text: The film uses no new on-camera interviews, instead relying primarily on archival interviews, press kit footage, in-progress and completed footage from the films being covered, and personal film/videos shot (often against company policy) by the employees of the animation studio.

evidence.title: Waking Sleeping Beauty
evidence.text: "Waking Sleeping Beauty" debuted at the 2009 Telluride Film Festival, and played at film festivals across the country before its limited theatrical release on March 26, 2010 by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures.

evidence.text: Fernando Di Leo( 11 January 1932 – 2 December 2003) was an Italian film director and script writer born in San Ferdinando di Puglia, Italy.

evidence.title: Fernando Di Leo
evidence.text: During his career from 1964 to 1985, Di Leo directed 20 films and was involved in the writing process in 43.

evidence.title: Fernando Di Leo
evidence.text: His films influenced many popular contemporary directors, such as Quentin Tarantino and John Woo.

evidence.title: Fernando Di Leo
evidence.text: Di Leo started his career mostly writing scripts for spaghetti westerns.

evidence.title: Fernando Di Leo
evidence.text: He worked on the script for" Per un pugno di dollariA Fistful of Dollars", 1964) and later as assistant director and assistant to Sergio Leone in" Per qualche dollaro in più For a Few Dollars More", 1965).

evidence.title: Fernando Di Leo
evidence.text: Later, he wrote scripts for such westerns as" Navajo Joe"( 1966) and" Johnny Yuma"( 1967).

evidence.title: Fernando Di Leo
evidence.text: Di Leo is now best remembered for his" poliziotteschi" films, especially the" Milieu Trilogy", which he both wrote and directed.
